name: guided-pr-review
description: Turn a GitHub pull request into a guided walkthrough: Overview, chaptered Guide, and Diff, as one self-contained HTML page.

scripts.sample: node scripts/cli.mjs --pr-data samples/ky-760.pr.json --analysis samples/ky-760.json --out samples --name ky-760 && node scripts/cli.mjs --pr-data samples/ky-873.pr.json --analysis samples/ky-873.json --out samples --name ky-873
scripts.check: node --check scripts/cli.mjs && node --check scripts/fetch-pr.mjs && node --check scripts/analyze.mjs && node --check scripts/render.mjs
